declarations.explanation: Majors (node_modules after pnpm install --frozen-lockfile): Vite 8.1.0 with @vitejs/plugin-react, React 19.2.7, Tailwind CSS 4.3.1, TypeScript 7.0.2, Vitest 5.0.5 for the existing tests, oxlint 1.90.0, Prettier 3.9.10; no ESLint or Biome. package.json pins packageManager pnpm@11.28.9 with one root pnpm-lock.yaml and no App npm lockfile; engines.node is ^24 || ^26. validate runs format:check, lint (oxlint --type-aware --deny-warnings), typecheck, test:run, check:architecture, check:docs, ui:check and build; it neither calls nor replaces scripts/validate.mjs. pnpm validate passed locally on Node 24.22.0 and its log shows 'ui:check passed (2 files)', so ui:check actually executes. dependency-cruiser parses with a private TypeScript 6.0.3 (pnpm-workspace.yaml packageExtensions) because dependency-cruiser 18 reads 0 modules under TypeScript 7; the App compiles with 7.0.2, deliberate api->app, page->ui and custom->app imports failed check:architecture under that toolchain (PR #16), and the development guide records the parser. shadcn: components.json was created by the pinned CLI with style base-nova, iconLibrary lucide, baseColor neutral, CSS variables and the old aliases; shadcn 4.23.0 is an exact devDependency; ui:add and ui:update invoke it through scripts/ui-registry.mjs. Integrity: registry-manifest.json hashes every file in src/components/ui; ui:check fails on changed, missing and unexpected files (controls in PR #16 and scripts/ui-registry.test.mjs); ui:add and ui:update stop when the output has already drifted; Prettier and oxlint ignore the generated directory. Wrappers: pages import only src/components/app (dependency-cruiser rule registry-components-only-through-app); AppButton, AppIconButton and AppTooltip hold shared invariants (telemetry typography, glass icon treatment, 250 ms delay, 300 ms skip window, 10 px offset, Escape propagation) and forward props, ref, className and composition through Base UI render; the YouTube link stays an <a> via render with nativeButton={false}. Custom provider glyphs live in src/components/custom with rule custom-components-stay-below-app. No effect is shared by every component of a kind, so no data-slot stylesheet rule is needed: the glass treatment applies only to icon buttons through AppIconButton. Theme: light tokens in :root and dark tokens in .dark in src/theme/tokens.css, no .light; ThemeProvider and the index.html boot script toggle only .dark, with dark the default and saved light/dark/system honoured before first paint (boot capture in PR #16). The colour theme is the App's own and unchanged. CI: .github/workflows/ci.yml runs pnpm validate on Node.js 24 and 26 shards behind the Validate site gate; on PR #16 a Node-26-only failure and a skipped matrix both failed the gate (runs 41221134404, 41221230388), and the merged main commit ae16c06 produced Validate site plus both shards (run 41232376247, success). Setup and validation in docs/development/README.md names pnpm 11, Node.js 24/26, every validate step and its tool, and the required checks. UI before/after evidence (six paired views, tooltip timing, keyboard and link semantics) is in PR #16's body; Space also activates the Base UI non-native link button, recorded there as a limit.
